name: add the reduced combination of each pair until every pair reduces to zero
mechanism: for every pair in the current set, form the combination that cancels their leading terms, reduce it by the whole set, and if anything remains add it as a new member; when every pair reduces to zero the set is closed and reduction by it decides membership

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Buchberger's algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Computer algebra: finds a Gröbner basis

requires: a well-founded order on leading terms
fails_when: intermediate expression swell; doubly exponential worst case
